title: Karlovy Vary regional hospital — information system
money_note: ~70.9M CZK vč. DPH; registr smluv, Jun 2026
summary: Karlovarská krajská nemocnice signed a ~70.9M CZK contract for delivery and service support of a hospital information system (27 Jun 2026). Registr smluv also shows a psychiatric-hospital NIS wave in the same weeks: PN Horní Beřkovice (~9.7M + 8.1M support), DPN Opařany (~9.3M), PN Marianny Oranžské (~6.0M) — four more buyers below or beside the TED threshold.
notes: - Relevance: receipt for p-0022 (hospital eHealth interoperability) — with the TED cluster (Uherské Hradiště, Plzeň group, Zlín, Olomouc) this makes 8+ distinct public hospital buyers procuring NIS/interop separately in one summer. The psychiatric hospitals' near-identical "pořízení NIS" contracts within days of each other are the clearest evidence yet that the same problem is being re-bought with no shared platform.

title: Františkov senior home — electricity-sharing contract
money_note: ~1.0M CZK vč. DPH service contract; registr smluv, Jul 2026
summary: Dům seniorů Františkov (Liberec, municipal senior home) signed 'Smlouva o zajištění sdílení elektřiny č. 58' (~1.0M CZK) — a real, numbered electricity-sharing service contract in the registr smluv. Public institutions are buying shared-electricity services; the provider's contract numbering (č. 58) implies a series.
notes:
- One of 37 komunitní energetika / energetické společenství contracts in the registr smluv since 2026-06-01 (hlidac-energycom bucket) — the sharing regime is producing signed service contracts, not just builds.
- Relevance: receipt for p-0001 — the buyer type the problem names (public institutions in sharing communities) is demonstrably paying for sharing services; settlement/billing is the unserved layer next to it.

title: Židlochovicko water utility — smart metering
money_note: ~8.4M CZK vč. DPH across two contracts (supply 4.8M + operations 3.6M); registr smluv
summary: Vodovody a kanalizace Židlochovicko signed two smart-metering contracts on one day (30 Jul 2026): meter+reader supply ~4.8M CZK and system operation/support ~3.6M CZK — a fourth distinct small water utility buying remote metering in the window, procured as supply plus outsourced operation.
notes:
- Complements the TED pair (Kroměříž award — whose signed contract also appears in registr smluv at ~21.4M CZK, smlouvy.gov.cz/smlouva/38292247 — and Ivančice open tender) and PVS Praha (~12M CZK, Jun 2026). The hlidac-watermeter bucket shows 259 vodoměr-related contracts since June.
- Relevance: receipt for p-0026 — the operate-and-support contract half is the exact managed-service shape the problem statement predicts small utilities need.

title: Český Brod — municipal cyber-security package
money_note: ~9.0M CZK vč. DPH; registr smluv, Aug 2026
summary: Město Český Brod (a ~7k-inhabitant town) signed 'Kybernetická bezpečnost města Český Brod' for ~9.0M CZK (11 Aug 2026). Registr smluv shows 341 cyber-security contracts since June, including NPO výzva č. 41 'Kyberbezpečnost' subsidy-funded audits (ZZS Středočeského kraje, město Jaroměř) — the small-municipality tier below TED's threshold is buying, and a subsidy stream funds it.
notes: - Relevance: receipt for p-0008 — extends the receipted buying pattern from hospitals/Prague (TED) down to small towns, and confirms the NPO subsidy channel (výzva č. 41) that the problem record listed as an open follow-up. Subsidy-funded compliance = the buyer's budget objection is partly pre-solved.

title: Kroměříž water utility — smart-metering system
summary: Vodovody a kanalizace Kroměříž awarded ~€1.3M to build a smart-metering system for the water network. Small water utilities are buying smart metering as one-off infrastructure projects.
notes:
- Paired with ted-430180-2026 (SVaK Ivančice, ~€1.2M, OPEN) and VaK Bruntál's data dispatch tender (~€0.5M): three small water utilities procuring metering/telemetry separately in ten weeks.
- Relevance: evidence for a candidate problem — CZ's fragmented water-utility sector (hundreds of VaKs and svazky) digitizes metering piecemeal with no shared platform or managed service.

title: Motol + Homolka hospitals — cyber threat detection
money_note: award (closed), dynamic purchasing system for ICT; buyer FN Motol a Homolka
summary: Fakultní nemocnice Motol + Homolka awarded ~€6.1M for a cyber-threat detection & response tool ('Výzva č. 113 – Nástroj pro detekci a reakci na kybernetické hrozby', dynamic purchasing system). Hospital NIS2/ZKB security spending is real and large.
notes:
- One of a June–August 2026 cluster of public cyber-security procurements (see ted-472636-2026, ted-542109-2026, plus smaller hospital awards: Nemocnice Hustopeče ~€1.4M, Nemocnice Třebíč ~€1.2M, Národní knihovna ~€1.4M).
- Relevance: money receipt for p-0008 (NIS2 implementation capacity) — obligated entities are spending millions per institution on detection/response tooling, mostly via SIs and DNS mechanisms.

title: Petrovice u Karviné — community energy installation
money_note: award (closed), design & build; buyer obec Petrovice u Karviné
summary: Obec Petrovice u Karviné awarded ~€278k for a design-and-build community energy installation ('Komunitní energetika v obci Petrovice u Karviné'). First TED receipt showing municipal budgets flowing into community energy delivery.
notes:
- Relevance: money receipt for p-0001 (energy community settlement) — municipalities are procuring community-energy builds; every completed build becomes a settlement/billing customer with no software to run member allocation.
- Modest value, but it upgrades p-0001's money dimension from assumption to receipt: relevant tenders exist.

title: Ministry of Labour — IT delivery III framework
money_note: framework award, recurring MPSV spend; adjacent to p-0004 (benefits IT budgets exist), not a direct navigation-product tender
summary: MPSV 'IT delivery III' framework — ~€74.7M for programming and consultancy services on the benefits-administration application stack (CPV 722xx), one of a dozen related MPSV awards in the window (EKIS III ~€19.8M open, důchodové dávky APV ~€8.2M open, OKaplikace ~€65M). The state spends heavily on benefit back-office IT while the citizen-facing navigation layer stays unbuilt.
notes:
- Relevance: money-context receipt for p-0004 (care-allowance navigation). MPSV demonstrably budgets tens of millions of EUR annually for benefits IT — a solver improving the příspěvek na péči journey has a named, funded buyer, though no navigation-specific tender exists yet.
- Honest limit: this is adjacent spend. Scored as money=1 (relevant tender exists in the problem's domain), not money=2.

title: Ivančice water association — smart-metering installation
money_note: OPEN competition; buyer SVaK Ivančice (municipal association)
summary: Svazek vodovodů a kanalizací Ivančice tendering smart-metering installation on the water network — open competition ~€1.2M (deadline 2026-07-20, re-published 2026-07-07). Second small-utility smart-metering buy in the window.
notes: - Relevance: open-tender receipt for the water-utility smart metering problem; municipal associations (svazky) are the buyer type — small, numerous, no in-house IT.

title: Bata regional hospital Zlín — hospital information system
money_note: award (closed); buyer Krajská nemocnice T. Bati a.s.
summary: Krajská nemocnice T. Bati (Zlín) awarded ~€2.8M for a hospital information system (NIS) including integration services. Third distinct regional buyer in the hospital-IT cluster.
notes: - Relevance: supporting receipt for the hospital eHealth interoperability problem — NIS replacements at €2-3M per hospital, each with custom integration scope.

title: Digital agency — national EU identity wallet build
money_note: open competition, estimated value; buyer Digitální a informační agentura
summary: DIA (Digitální a informační agentura) tendered the client part of the Czech EU Digital Identity Wallet (EUDIW) — open competition, estimated ~€78.2M (~1.9bn CZK), CPV 72xxx. The state is buying the national wallet build now, which starts the countdown for every Czech relying party's acceptance obligation.
notes:
- Notice: "KLIENTSKÁ ČÁST EVROPSKÉ PENĚŽENKY DIGITÁLNÍ IDENTITY (EUDIW)", published 2026-07-02, form type competition (open at fetch time).
- Relevance: hard money receipt for p-0017 (EUDI wallet acceptance). The wallet client being procured at this scale confirms the national wallet ships on the eIDAS2 timeline, which triggers the 2027 relying-party acceptance obligations for banks/telcos/KYC businesses.
- Money: single largest open IT tender in the CZ TED window (Jun–Aug 2026) relevant to the register.

title: City of Prague — SIEM security-event platform
money_note: award (closed); buyer Hlavní město Praha; scope MHMP + MPP + městské části
summary: Hlavní město Praha awarded ~€5.3M for a SIEM tool for collection and advanced analysis of security events across MHMP, city police and city districts. Municipal-scale NIS2/ZKB security buying, complementing the hospital cluster.
notes:
- Paired with ted-542109-2026 (central cyber platform for Prague city districts, ~€1.9M, 2026-08-05): Prague alone placed two security-platform awards inside six weeks.
- Relevance: money receipt for p-0008 — recurring annual spend pattern across municipal buyers, not one-off.

title: Plzeň region hospitals — NIS delivery & integrations
money_note: OPEN competition at fetch time; multi-hospital buyer group, Plzeňský kraj
summary: Nemocnice Plzeňského kraje group (Klatovy, Rokycany, Stod...) tendering NIS delivery, ESB and integrations for the group's eHealth programme — open competition, ~€5.8M. A second regional buyer procuring hospital interoperability as a bespoke project.
notes: - Relevance: open-tender money receipt for the hospital eHealth interoperability problem; with ted-549134-2026 and ted-443904-2026 it shows ≥3 regional buyers in 10 weeks, each solving the same integration problem separately.

title: City of Prague — central cyber platform for districts
money_note: award (closed); buyer Hlavní město Praha for městské části
summary: Hlavní město Praha awarded ~€1.9M for a central cyber-security platform serving the city districts (městské části). Third public cyber award in the window; smaller municipalities and district offices are buying security capacity they cannot staff.
notes: - Relevance: supporting money receipt for p-0008 — shows the buying pattern extends below ministry/hospital level to district offices, the exact segment the problem statement says lacks capacity.

title: Uherské Hradiště hospital — eHealth platform
summary: Uherskohradišťská nemocnice awarded ~€7.7M to create an eHealth platform for communication, exchange and sharing of information between providers. Regional hospitals are each buying bespoke interoperability platforms.
notes:
- Part of a hospital-eHealth procurement cluster in the window: Plzeňský kraj hospital group NIS+ESB+integrations (~€5.8M, OPEN — ted-476712-2026), Krajská nemocnice T. Bati NIS (~€2.8M award — ted-443904-2026), FN Olomouc interoperability (~€0.7M).
- Relevance: evidence for a new problem — Czech hospital interoperability is being bought hospital-by-hospital as bespoke SI projects with no product platform, just as EHDS obligations approach.
